sources.entry: Dokuwiki - Easy to use, lightweight, standards-compliant wiki engine with a simple syntax allowing reading the data outside the wiki. All data is stored in plain text files, therefore no database is required. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: DokuWiki is a lightweight, standards-compliant wiki engine that stores all page data in plain text files, so no database is needed.
summary.what_it_does: The README is almost empty: it only points to online documentation and installation instructions, and names the copyright holder (Andreas Gohr and the DokuWiki Community) and a license file. The wiki features described come from the awesome-selfhosted listing: a simple syntax, all data stored as plain text files with no database required, and page data readable outside the wiki. The README does not detail specific features beyond this.
notable: All data stored in plain text files, no database required
Page data can be read outside the wiki
caveats: README is nearly empty; installation and feature details are only available on the linked external documentation
Requires a PHP-capable web server to run, as implied by the PHP stack
